phases.goal: Lift the bread and set it in the breadbasket.
phases.name: place_bread_in_basket
phases.verify: Bread rests inside the basket and gripper is clear.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: Phases are transferable task guidance; the companion JSONL is the exact historical winning command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize all objects, supports, contacts, and poses from current observations; do not reuse s0 coordinates.
critical_gates: Bread is supported inside the basket before release.

task_language: Lift the golden baked bread and set it in the brown breadbasket.
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=2,use_length=50); 2:release(arm=left). For every lingbot_act, use the original task_language exactly; relocalize every pose from current observations; do not replay clean coordinates.

notes: Avoid carrying bread after an unverified grasp; confirm the bread moves with the gripper and is visibly inside the basket before release.
